purpose: Measure the trained actor without decision-time simulations when the primary finalist uses online search.
selection: Choose the best standalone actor by six-cell mean win-rate improvement on the 320-deals-per-cell development bank starting at 1813247161. Freeze this actor and the primary finalist before opening either test bank. Always report this supplementary comparison when run.
scoring: Use the same frozen opponents, all seat rotations, raw wins and equal-weight six-cell mean as the primary benchmark.
